headlines.text: US strikes on Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz send oil surging and stocks lower to start the week.
National gas prices topped $4 a gallon every day of August for the first time ever as fresh US-Iran strikes push oil higher.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks push December rate-hike odds above 70% despite cooler PCE and CPI readings.
S&P 500 and Dow close lower Monday on the oil shock, though the S&P still notches a 2.6% gain for August.
10-year Treasury yield climbs to its highest level since January 2025 as the oil spike and hawkish Fed talk stoke inflation fears.
Earnings scorecard: Gap jumps on a new Old Navy CEO and raised guidance, while Marvell slides on weak margin guidance despite beating estimates.
